Fix bug: Dice audio buffers not freed when leaving arena
## Steps to reproduce
Enter The Arena, interact to trigger dice sound preload, leave to map, re-enter. On re-entry, dice sounds should be re-fetched.
## Expected
Dice audio buffers cleared on arena exit; re-entering re-fetches sounds
## Actual
page.waitForSelector: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.
Call log:
[2m  - waiting for locator('[data-testid="map-popup-enter"]') to be visible[22m

## Suspected files
- client/src/components/DiceOverlay.jsx
- client/src/components/DicePanel.jsx
- client/src/pages/Arena.jsx
- client/src/hooks/useUiSounds.js
- client/src/hooks/useArenaSounds.js
- client/src/lib/sceneAudioEngine.js
## Console errors
- Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)
## Test file: arena-audio.spec.js
Re-run with: npx playwright test --grep "dice audio buffers are cleared when leaving the arena"
